column2: Smoke manifest: ONE small, fast entry that exercises the entire stack.
This is not science - it is the end-to-end test that tools/sims.tsv is too
expensive to be. It runs martinize2, Packmol, insane, grompp, energy
minimization, NVT, NPT and two adaptive chunks with PLUMED, so every stage
the real batch depends on is executed for real, in minutes rather than days.
Deliberately small: 2 copies instead of 5, a 60 A packing sphere instead of
145, 500 equilibration steps instead of 10000/50000, and 0.004 us of
production. --relax is omitted: relaxing one protomer is ~110 minutes and
--atoms-per-prot 236 is the measured bead count of the 1-108 protomer. See
RUNBOOK.md for why that number matters and how it was got wrong.
